changes: Added a deterministic A/B hintMode (core/hint-mode.ts resolveHintMode = sha256(storyId) first-byte parity => on/off) and shadow-gated the advisory experience-hints section in handlers/story-review.ts: hints are still computed and the experience_hint_surfaced event still fires (now carrying hintMode) on BOTH arms, but the section is RENDERED into _reviewPrompt only in the ON arm. This is the unconfounded forward-A/B apparatus — no story loses measurement (the would-have-hinted set is recorded for OFF too), only the ON arm gets the reviewer-facing nudge. Hints stay advisory-only: issues/blocker and resolveReviewPromptHash are byte-identical between arms; core/review-run.ts untouched.
usage: No new command. resolveHintMode(storyId) decides the arm deterministically. ON-arm stories show the 'Project experience hints (advisory only)' section in story_review _reviewPrompt; OFF-arm stories do not. The experience_hint_surfaced activity event now carries hintMode (on/off) for ③.4 to read.
expectedOutcome: story_review on an ON-arm story shows the experience-hints section; on an OFF-arm story it is hidden; both record an experience_hint_surfaced event with the correct hintMode; issues/blocker and promptHash unchanged.
actualTranscript: Smoke (14/14) confirms: resolveHintMode deterministic + ~balanced + non-string coercion never corrupts the arm; ON-arm _reviewPrompt CONTAINS the section, OFF-arm does NOT; event fires on both arms with hintMode + full hintIds; issues/blocker identical between arms; OFF-arm prompt byte-identical to the no-hints baseline; resolveReviewPromptHash byte-identical regardless of arm. Verifier 42/42 (hintModePure, storyReviewGated, reviewRunUntouched all true). Full npm test green incl. process-fact-contract.
outcomeDiff: Matches expected: deterministic arms, shadow measurement preserved, advisory isolation intact.
limitations: By design, ~half of stories (the OFF control arm) now see no experience-hints section in their review prompt — this is the point of the A/B, not a regression. ③.3 builds the apparatus; it does NOT itself prove hints help — that is the accruing RCT readout in ③.4. No effectiveness metric, no historical backfill (③.5), no cross-repo.
pitfalls: The critical invariant: gating must stay in the advisory _reviewPrompt only — hints must never enter resolveReviewPromptHash or the issues/blocker computation (verified byte-identical between arms; review-run.ts untouched). The OFF arm must still COMPUTE hints + fire the event (shadow) or ③.4 goes half-blind. Round 1 surfaced 2 test-coverage findings (resolved) → degraded 3x1 escalation per solo-operator policy; the pre-existing hint-injection smoke needed an onArmId() helper because A/B gating now hides the section for OFF-arm storyIds.
